item.title: [The MAD Podcast with Matt Turck] Who Feeds the GPUs? Inside AI's Hidden $30B Layer | Renen Hallak, VAST Data
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:17 Sometimes it scares me. We had a customer, one of these AI clouds, they said we're probably going to need about 500 petabytes over the next three years. Last week, came back to us and said, we're gonna need an extra two exabytes on top of that 500 petabytes. I think in the next ten years, we'll see more difference than we did in the last thousand years.
